channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Após desvantagem no primeiro turno, Lula diminui falas sobre bets e evita falar de futebol
item.description: After Flávio Bolsonaro's lead in the first round, Lula's campaign reduced references to bets in speeches and avoids discussing football impacts. The strategy aims to refocus on core campaign issues.

item.title: Analistas esperam BNDES mais enxuto em eventual governo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Analysts expect a more restrained BNDES role in economic financing if Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) takes office in 2026. The outlook points to a conservative approach compared to previous administrations.

item.title: "Lula está cagando para Amazônia”, diz Flávio ao ser cobrado sobre fumaça
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Lula for not fighting Amazon fires and claimed he would address the issue if elected. In Manaus, he was pressed about the smoke covering the city and promised action against wildfires.

item.title: O controle e o rastreamento de armas e munições - O Assunto #1828
item.description: In episode #1828 of the podcast O Assunto, Roberto Uchôa discusses the need to modernize the State to combat crime, emphasizing the importance of controlling and tracking firearms and ammunition. The debate covers data on violence in Brazil, including the use of firearms in 70% of homicides and joint police actions supported by technologies such as the DNA Database.

item.title: Depois da emoção da campanha, uma grande tarefa nos espera
item.description: The article highlights the final stretch of the 2026 Brazilian election, emphasizing the tension and stakes of the runoff. With a reflective tone, it points to the challenges the winner will face upon taking office, especially in areas like the economy, security, and structural reforms. Available exclusively to subscribers, the analysis offers an in-depth look at the key issues shaping the vote.

item.title: Eleições 2026: acompanhe a apuração em todo o Brasil
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections feature real-time vote counting coverage by g1, including results for the presidency and runoff elections in five states and the Federal District. Data is provided by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) and updated live with interactive maps, charts, and detailed regional analysis.

item.title: Bolsa Família: veja o novo calendário após governo antecipar pagamentos antes do 2º turno das eleições
item.description: The federal government advanced Bolsa Família payments to before the second round of elections, benefiting all recipients with adjusted amounts before October 25. The payment schedule was condensed into three days, with a 15% increase in the minimum family benefit from R$600 to R$691. The measure aims to mitigate the effects of the super El Niño on vulnerable families.

item.title: Raio-X do Fla: números de Jardim são melhores que o de Filipe Luís no comando do rubro-negro em torneio nacional; veja comparativo
item.description: Leonardo Jardim outperformed Filipe Luís in points accumulated over the first 28 Brazilian Championship games for Flamingo, but showed a weaker defense. The Portuguese coach reached 63 points against 61 from his predecessor, scoring one more goal but conceding six more, leading to a less favorable goal difference (+36 vs +41).

item.title: Ato anti-Lula no campus da UFRN termina em pancadaria e briga generalizada
item.description: An anti-Lula rally at UFRN ended in clashes and fighting between right-wing groups and students, leaving injuries and property damage. The event, organized by conservative movements and supported by PL political figures, triggered academic disruption and class cancellations. The incident reflects the polarization surrounding education and security issues on campus.

item.title: Com Nikolas e Pavanato, Flávio reúne multidão em Manaus
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a campaign rally called 'Bloquinho do 22' in Manaus, accompanied by federal deputies Nikolas Ferreira and Lucas Pavanato, the two most voted candidates for the Chamber in 2026. The event gathered supporters in western Manaus with displays of support for the presidential race and the state government of Amazonas.

item.title: Lula diz que foi convencido a mudar opinião sobre maioridade penal
item.description: President Lula stated he was convinced to support lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 for heinous crimes, proposing a Senate amendment. He advocates strict punishment for 16-year-olds committing serious crimes, likening it to voting rights. Lula also defended temporary prison leaves ('saidinhas') as part of social rehabilitation, rejecting criticism over rare recidivism cases.

item.title: Campanha de Lula recorre ao TSE para acusar Meta de descumprir ordem judicial e prejudicar PT
item.description: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of failing to comply with a TSE order and favoring Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, filing a new motion with the court. The PT alleges the platform's AI generates content referencing candidate number 22 without direct mention. European and OAS observers participated in discussions regarding the allegations.

item.title: Incrédula com força de Flávio, eleitora de Lula diz que democracia está em jogo
item.description: A Lula voter in upscale Fortaleza neighborhoods says democracy is at stake, expressing support for the candidacy with strength akin to Flávio's. The text highlights the contrast between local life and the voter's political stance.

item.title: Inquérito sobre suspeita de lavagem de Flávio Bolsonaro também investiga Cláudio Castro e Ramagem
item.description: The Federal Police investigation into suspected money laundering involving Flávio Bolsonaro also investigates Cláudio Castro and Alexandre Ramagem. The probe examines potential misconduct by the three PL politicians.

item.title: Agora a favor de reduzir a idade penal, Lula já disse que proposta era coisa da elite brasileira; relembre
item.description: President Lula reversed his stance and now supports lowering the criminal age from 18 to 16 for heinous crimes, despite previously criticizing the proposal as elite-driven. The statement was made during a TV Globo interview.

item.title: Maiores Assembleias de Deus explicitam apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro, e Universal permanece neutra
item.description: Leaders of the Great Church of God stated open support for Flávio Bolsonaro, whereas the Universal Church remains neutral. The Pentecostal movement's political influence continues to grow in this 2026 election.

item.title: Tarcísio teve 5 agendas oficiais e 12 da campanha de Flávio no segundo turno
item.description: Since the beginning of the runoff, São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas fulfilled five official duties and attended 12 campaign events for Flávio Bolsonaro, according to public records.

item.title: Comitê de Lula em Joinville (SC) é alvo de ataque: "Intimidação"
item.description: Lula's campaign committee in Joinville (SC) was attacked on the night of October 19th when a man threw a 5kg stone at the glass door. No one was injured, and the group, led by Larissa Stephanie (PCdoB), condemned the attack and demanded action against political intimidation. Police have not yet responded.

item.title: Performance de Flávio Bolsonaro em debate revela inspiração em Marçal, Trump e Jair
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) delivered a stronger debate performance on Band, contrasting with his 2016 stumble in Rio. He referenced inspirations like Marçal, Trump, and Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: A última pesquisa PoderData sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula no segundo turno
item.description: The new PoderData survey, released on October 25, will measure the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff. The latest round, from October 16-18, showed Flávio with 52% of valid votes against Lula's 48%. The survey will investigate voting intentions, voter conviction, and perceptions of who is more likely to win.

item.title: Gusttavo Lima declara voto em Flávio Bolsonaro durante show
item.description: Gusttavo Lima endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro during a show at Expo Assis 2026, hinting at votes in the second round. The singer, who previously supported Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, confirmed he will not run in 2026.

item.title: Flávio faz motociata no Pará; Lula participa de marcha no RS
item.description: Candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula held campaign events in Pará and Rio Grande do Sul. Flávio emphasized land regularization, environmental deregulation, and crime fighting, while Lula highlighted the benefit of 3.6 million individual entrepreneurs with debt forgiveness approved by Congress.

item.title: Lula desconversa sobre indicação ao STF: “Primeiro vou ganhar eleição”
item.description: President Lula stated he did not suffer political backlash after the Senate rejected Jorge Messias for the STF and emphasized that winning the elections is his priority before making new nominations. He also advocated for judicial reform and greater societal participation in selecting Supreme Court justices.

item.title: Lula promete Ministério da Segurança mesmo se perder eleição
item.description: Lula promised to create the Ministry of Public Security even if he loses the election to Flávio Bolsonaro, conditional on the approval of a constitutional amendment. He advocated for more budget and police staffing, and opposed using the Army in security operations.

item.title: A variável de instabilidade na campanha de Lula, segundo cientista político
item.description: Lobbiester Roberta Luchsinger's statements about alleged connections with the government and Lula's relatives created a new instability factor for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's reelection campaign. Political scientist Murilo Medeiros warns that the episode may harm the PT's recovery in polls and shift campaign focus to corruption suspicions, especially among undecided voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro já tentou limitar a 2 anos programa social que chamou de 'bolsa-farelo'
item.description: In 2011, Flávio Bolsonaro proposed limiting the Rio’s Renda Melhor program to two years, calling it 'bolsa-farelo', but the amendment was rejected. Now, his economic team suggests a similar rule for Bolsa Família, with a two-year transition for beneficiaries who find formal jobs or start businesses.

item.title: Lula oferece fim de sigilos de Janja e Lulinha, e cobra de Flávio Bolsonaro dados de offshore de Willer Tomaz
item.description: President Lula authorized the lifting of banking secrecy for Flávio Bolsonaro's relatives and companies, demanding offshore data linked to his friend Willer Tomaz. The move aims to boost transparency and pressure the senator to disclose details about his foreign accounts.

item.title: TSE mantém propaganda em que Lula diz que Flávio Bolsonaro era contra o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: The TSE upheld an ad in which Lula claims Flávio Bolsonaro opposed ending the 6x1 scale, rejecting the PL candidate’s appeal. The ruling deemed the statement non-abusive and not factually false, though it will be reviewed by the full panel. The vote takes place amid political polarization and threats to democracy.

item.title: Governo não explica por que deixou Bolsa Família mais de três anos sem reajuste em processo que tramitou em apenas um dia
item.description: The federal government fails to explain why it left Bolsa Família without adjustment for over three years, only correcting it in October, an electoral month. The 15.04% increase was formalized in a single document on September 16th under secrecy and without clear justification, sparking criticism over political motivation.

item.title: Lula diz que vai ser ‘briguinha’ com Congresso tirar dinheiro de emenda para garantir passe-livre
item.description: Lula proposes using parliamentary amendments funds to set free public transportation fares on weekends and holidays, willing to challenge the National Congress to get the measure approved, estimated to cost between R$ 8 billion and R$ 12 billion annually. He also supports reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for serious crimes and maintaining temporary release for inmates.

item.title: Onde Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula erraram no debate da Band
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was marked by personal attacks and few proposals, according to VEJA's politics editor José Benedito. Flávio showed improved poise but overdid provocations, while Lula struggled with responses.

item.title: Lula diz duvidar que Congresso mais à direita retome escala 6 X 1
item.description: Lula doubts the right-wing Congress will reverse the 6x1 work schedule, noting that many already use 5x2 and advocating for the free bus fare amendment for weekends, projected to cost BRL 16 billion annually funded by lawmakers' amendments.

item.title: Lula diz que não vai deixar de dar benefício por causa da eleição
item.description: President Lula stated he will not condition social benefits such as the Bolsa Família increase to the electoral calendar, emphasizing that the measure has already been implemented and will benefit the population. He also criticized financial market pressure on fiscal policy and reinforced his strategy to win votes in the South, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo.

item.title: Lula nega “bomba fiscal” e critica a autonomia do BC
item.description: Lula denied that the social measures announced pose a risk to public accounts and criticized the autonomy of the Central Bank, claiming it limits the Executive's action. He highlighted the projected primary surplus of 0.1% and compared his government with that of Fernando Henrique Cardoso, asserting greater fiscal seriousness.

item.title: O que realmente significa a movimentação de Flávio e Lula nas últimas pesquisas
item.description: Recent polls by AtlasIntel and BTG/Nexus show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula, but by a shrinking margin, indicating a static race without sharp shifts. José Benedito notes both candidates struggle to gain new voters near the end. Lula has used government tools, like the Bolsa Família raise, to boost his standing.

item.title: Populismo de campanha vira tesouraço depois, mas Lula e Flávio escondem o jogo
item.description: The 2026 presidential campaign reveals last-minute populist tactics, such as Lula's advance of social benefits and Flávio Bolsonaro's idealistic speech, without concrete proposals to address the fiscal crisis. Both candidates avoid discussing structural issues, favoring electoral strategies that worsen the future fiscal crisis. Candidate Daniella Marques, by referencing Milei's Argentina, exposes the disconnect between rhetoric and reality.

item.title: Não subestimei capacidade de Flávio e da direita, diz Lula
item.description: Lula denied underestimating Flávio Bolsonaro and the right, stating that conservative forces have grown globally. He expressed frustration over not winning the first round and drew parallels to the 2002 elections. The PT candidate emphasized the need to recover votes in regions such as Northeast, South, Minas Gerais and São Paulo.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro apaga posts em que criticava Bolsa Família e chamava benefício de ‘bolsa-farelo’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) deleted old posts where he criticized the Bolsa Família program, referring to it as 'bolsa-farelo' and questioning its methodology. These posts from 2011-2014 show a previously opposing stance toward the social program, but are now removed from his X account. His campaign did not respond regarding the reasons for deletion.

item.title: Lula cita proposta inexistente de Haddad em 2018 sobre redução da maioridade e admite que mudou de opinião
item.description: In an interview with SBT, President Lula stated that he changed his opinion regarding the reduction of the criminal majority age and referenced a proposal he claims was discussed in Haddad's 2018 campaign, even though that proposal was not part of the official platform. Lula supports lowering the majority age to 16 for heinous crimes, countering the right-wing push to set it at 14.

item.title: O único estado onde há maioria da esquerda na Assembleia Legislativa
item.description: Only Ceará maintains a left-wing majority in state deputies; across the other 26 states, the right leads the benches, notably in Amazonas where 91% of seats belong to conservative parties. Far-right gains are highlighted by 379 elected officials (36% of total), especially in five states where they secured absolute majorities.

item.title: Lula: Ninguém subestima a capacidade da direita neste País e no mundo
item.description: Lula stated that no one should underestimate the right-wing in Brazil and globally, noting its growth across nearly all countries. He expressed frustration over not winning in the first round but remained confident about securing victory in the second round.

item.title: Passe livre virá de emendas e vai gerar 'briguinha com Congresso', diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that the free public transportation on weekends will be funded through parliamentary amendments, rejecting criticism over state burden and anticipating potential debates in Congress.

item.title: Rogério Marinho: Não nos opusemos à volta de grupo 'Exército do Lula', apenas pedimos registro
item.description: Rogério Marinho, campaign manager for Flávio Bolsonaro, denied that the group opposed the return of the 'Lula Army' channel, claiming they only requested the live stream registration. He emphasized that there was no formal blockage of André Janones' content.

item.title: Meta prejudicou muito campanha de Lula; não dá para ela assumir lado na eleição, diz Edinho
item.description: Edinho Silva criticized Meta for allegedly harming Lula's campaign, stating that the company should not take sides in the election. He expressed concerns about the role of social media in the Brazilian presidential race.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: após debate, chefes de campanha divergem 'com todo respeito'
item.description: Following an intense debate filled with mutual accusations, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) kept up direct confrontation, while campaign managers respectfully disagreed on proposals for Brazil. The antagonistic tone persisted without major verbal escalation.

item.title: Revelação da esquerda brasileira, Ana Elisa leva Lula à era das selfies
item.description: Ana Elisa Santos, elected federal deputy for PT-MG, advises Lula on social media use for his fourth term. Born when Lula was already president, she represents a new generation in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Ouça áudio em que Daniella Marques cita nova regra no Bolsa Família
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, announced a two-year transition rule for Bolsa Família beneficiaries seeking formal employment or entrepreneurship, with automatic return to benefits if unsuccessful. Lula's allies used the statement to criticize Flávio, suggesting the program would end in two years. The announcement contrasts with Flávio's 76-page campaign plan, which does not mention the proposal.

item.title: PT diz que Meta restringiu perfil de Lula após debate
item.description: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of restricting the 'Brasil com Lula' profile after the Band debate, hindering collaboration features and reducing reach. The PT files a new complaint with the TSE over the company's failure to comply with Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze's ruling requiring equal treatment for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's campaigns. The campaign labels the restriction a 'technical failure' by Meta and demands ethical conduct from the company.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio minimiza áudio e diz que Bolsa Família seguirá forte
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign denied plans to end the Bolsa Família program, stating it will remain strong in his potential government. The statement came after controversy surrounding a proposed two-year transition period for beneficiaries, suggested by the campaign's economic coordinator, Daniella Marques. Bolsonaro released a video clarifying that beneficiaries will continue receiving aid for up to two years after securing formal employment or starting their own businesses.

item.title: Cúpula do PT quer Lula mais agressivo no tête-à-tête com Flávio no último debate da campanha
item.description: The PT leadership wants Lula to adopt a more aggressive tone in the final debate against Flávio Bolsonaro, pushing for the opening of financial records and linking the opponent to public security issues. The petist campaign also supports lowering the age of criminal responsibility and seeks to shift the debate away from topics that could benefit the PL. The strategy aims to tie corruption to the opponent and prevent Flávio from gaining political dividends.
